target.policy: Rules describe re-expression targets, not blanket permission to rewrite. SAFE_SYNTACTIC rules may be auto-applied only when their preconditions match exactly.

classes.SAFE_SYNTACTIC: Schema/path migrations intended to preserve meaning and structurally validate.
classes.STRUCTURAL_REIMPLEMENTATION: Rebuild legacy implementation around a more maintainable modern vanilla primitive; requires behavioral contract preservation.
classes.CANDIDATE_MODERNIZATION: Potentially better 26.3+ primitive; requires runtime A/B or explicit semantic-change approval.

rules.source_scope: data/*/predicate/**/*.json using pre-26.3-style top-level predicate discriminator
rules.transform: rename top-level condition to type without changing its value or sibling fields
preconditions: file is under a datapack predicate directory
top-level object contains condition
top-level object does not already contain type
validation: top-level type equals prior condition value
all other top-level fields are byte-semantically equivalent after JSON normalization

rules.source_scope: serialized block-state JSON objects using Name/Properties
rules.transform: rename block-state Name->id and Properties->properties when the object shape is identified as a block state
preconditions: Name is a string namespaced block id when present
Properties is an object when present
target keys do not already exist
hard_negatives: arbitrary objects whose Name/Properties fields are not block-state serialization

rules.transform: move path segment configured_carver to carver
preconditions: destination path does not already exist

rules.transform: move path segment configured_feature to feature
preconditions: destination path does not already exist

rules.transform: recover each legacy item-NBT field's intent and map it to explicit item components/custom_data
preconditions: component mapping exists for every behaviorally relevant legacy field
validation: runtime use/equip/consume checks where behavior exists
evidence: Minecraft Java 1.20.5 item stack component migration

rules.source_scope: legacy JSON text serialized inside strings or old hover/click event fields
rules.transform: parse legacy text component then re-emit the modern inline component/event representation
preconditions: legacy component parses without loss
evidence: Minecraft Java 1.21.5 text component format changes

rules.source_scope: legacy repeating/chain command-block or one-command-machine orchestration
rules.target_scope: 26.3+ datapack functions, tags, schedule, storage/scoreboard state
rules.transform: recover execution order/conditions/state, then lower to named functions and explicit scheduling/state storage
preconditions: causal execution order is recovered
conditionality and update cadence are known
hard_negatives: contraptions that depend on physical block updates, comparator output, minecart motion, or command-block spatial semantics

rules.source_scope: scoreboard arithmetic used primarily as temporary numeric computation
rules.transform: replace eligible ephemeral arithmetic pipelines with context number providers and /compute or /data ... compute
preconditions: scoreboard value is not externally observable/persistent game state
numeric type/overflow/rounding semantics match
hard_negatives: scoreboard is part of gameplay state/UI
operation depends on scoreboard integer overflow or ordering
validation: numeric differential test over boundary inputs

rules.source_scope: commands that detect item/block interaction and replace blocks manually

detect.pattern: execute .* if block .* run setblock|execute .* if items .* run setblock

rules.transform: encode interaction as block_transformer rule when trigger/effect semantics are equivalent
preconditions: transformation is directly tied to item-on-block interaction
provider can express resulting block state
hard_negatives: side effects beyond supported sound/particle/block result

rules.transform: recover reagent/input/output relation and re-express as a 26.3 brewing recipe where equivalent
preconditions: legacy behavior is a bounded brewing transformation
no extra world/actor side effects are essential
hard_negatives: ritual/state-machine behavior merely using a brewing stand as a prop

rules.source_scope: legacy client-visual illusion/hack whose intent is screen post-processing
rules.transform: replace only when recovered intent is post-processing rather than gameplay impairment
preconditions: visual-only intent is proven
resource-pack dependency is acceptable
hard_negatives: server needs authoritative knowledge of visual result

rules.source_scope: Block State SNBT compounds embedded in .mcfunction commands
rules.transform: within each balanced block_state:{...} compound only, rename top-level Name->id and Properties->properties
preconditions: text is parsed by balanced compound boundaries
rewrite is limited to top-level keys inside block_state compound
source and output paths differ
validation: rewritten command file preserves all non-target text
exact transformed legacy file may be compared byte-for-byte with a maintained 26.3 counterpart when available

rules.source_scope: 26.2 structure/biome spawn rows with minCount/maxCount integers
rules.transform: minCount==maxCount -> scalar count; otherwise -> minecraft:uniform IntProvider with min_inclusive/max_inclusive
preconditions: row is a Minecraft spawn-data entry
minCount and maxCount are integers
0 < minCount <= maxCount
count is absent
hard_negatives: non-spawn objects with similarly named fields
validation: exact Mojang 26.2->26.3 selected vanilla structure comparison
constant legacy counts map to identical scalar count
ranged legacy counts map to minecraft:uniform IntProvider
evidence: Minecraft 26.3 natural mob spawn data uses count IntProvider
